(function () {
// iOS / iPadOS / Mac touch (iPadOS sering "MacIntel")
var isIOS =
/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
(navigator.platform === "MacIntel" && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);

var done = false;
function dispatch(type) {
try {
window.dispatchEvent(new Event(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
} catch (e) {
try {
var ev = document.createEvent("Event");
ev.initEvent(type, true, true);
window.dispatchEvent(ev);
} catch (e2) {}
}
}
function start() {
if (done) return;
done = true;
// ⚠️ JANGAN pakai touchstart / mousedown (itu yang bikin click pertama ketahan)
dispatch("mousemove");
dispatch("wheel");
dispatch("keydown");
// ulang sedikit buat Safari yang kadang “delay nangkep”
setTimeout(function () {
dispatch("mousemove");
dispatch("keydown");
}, 80);
setTimeout(function () {
dispatch("wheel");
}, 180);
}
// secepat mungkin setelah DOM siap
if (document.readyState === "loading") {
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
requestAnimationFrame(start);
}, { once: true });
} else {
requestAnimationFrame(start);
}
// BFCache iOS (back/forward)
window.addEventListener("pageshow", function () {
setTimeout(start, 0);
}, { once: true });
})();

function startCok() {

durasi = 180000;

durasi = 500000;
}

dts = co.split("|");
setTimeout(function () {
